study_design: Integrated network of Italian and Swiss case-control studies
reason: The abstract reports an association between garlic intake and prostate cancer in case-control data but provides no aggressive prostate cancer endpoint or stage/grade definition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The multivariate ORs for the highest category of onion and garlic intake were, respectively, 0.16 and 0.61 for cancer of the oral cavity and pharynx, 0.12 and 0.43 for esophageal cancer, 0.44 and 0.74 for colorectal cancer, 0.17 and 0.56 for laryngeal cancer, 0.75 and 0.90 for breast cancer, 0.27 and 0.78 for ovarian cancer, 0.29 and 0.81 for prostate cancer, and 0.62 and 0.69 for renal cell cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The garlic OR of 0.81 is reported for prostate cancer generally, with no aggressive disease definition.
